content.comment_body: Hello! I've been working with [product_name] Web Editor for a few days and have encountered a significant issue on my pages. Some digital blocks do not update with their values when reading—about half of my [product_name] memory blocks remain Off and aren't refreshed on the web page. In my attachment, M32/M33 are shown as active in online mode, but the corresponding digital objects on the page aren't updated, while M34 and M35 display correctly. I attempted solutions like using a network output, rebuilding the object in [product_name] Web Editor, and moving the object to another page; none resolved the problem. Adding a new memory block did work, but since I'm using 61 out of 64 available blocks, modifying everything isn't feasible. I haven’t checked the HTML code yet but plan to do so tomorrow, and I haven’t changed any code on this particular page. Has anyone else faced this problem?
Please upload your project file and the [product_name] Web Editor project in a ZIP archive.

This is the most recent version I tested without custom code on the HTML pages. You can replicate the issue by testing the 'diagnostics' page—turn inputs 6/7/8/9 off on the [product_name] device and check which fault appears on the web page after 60 seconds; the corresponding blocks are on page 33 of the program. Also, the 'current mode' on the main page is connected via network output but still doesn't function (page 12 of the program). I checked the HTML pages and confirmed that fields such as range, address, type, and length seem correct. I'll try starting a new project to see what happens. Edit: Attachment removed.
I've loaded your projects into my [product_name] device and haven't found the errors you've mentioned. All digital values from M32 to M35 and V10.0 work as expected.

Transferring my pages to a new project resolved the issue! I'll still need to redo my tab table, though. It's possible that modifying the code caused errors, but it seems unlikely since the pages are regenerated when saving. Thank you for testing. I'll update if I encounter any more problems.
A new question by [user_name] has been opened in a separate thread titled 'How can I create a new topic?' Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users of [product_name] Web Editor report a significant problem where certain digital blocks, especially memory blocks, fail to update or display correctly on custom web pages, leading to inaccurate status information. Attempts to fix this, such as recreating or relocating objects or using other blocks, have not consistently worked. Starting a new project seems to resolve the issue, but it requires additional time and effort. The exact cause remains unclear, with possible suspicion of project or code corruption.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that all memory blocks in [product_name] Web Editor will accurately display their current status on web pages. They expect a reliable update mechanism and do not want to rebuild their entire project just to achieve standard functionality.
